blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent
Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be
sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. These results identify latent-frequency manipulation as a practical attack surface and highlight the need to include such
attacks in robustness evaluations of generative image watermarking.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The rapid advancement of generative AI has started a new era of photorealistic image synthesis. Modern diffusion-based and autoregressive models can produce images of remarkable quality, making it difficult to distinguish synthetic content from authentic photographs. While these capabilities unlock significant creative and commercial potential, they also create critical societal challenges: preventing AI-generated misinformation, deepfakes, and fabricated visual content.
blocks.zh: 基因AI的快速进步开始了光现实主义图像合成的新时代. 现代的以扩散为主和自相递进的模型可以产生出质量出众的图像,使得合成内容与真实相片难以区分. 虽然这些能力释放出巨大的创造和商业潜力,但也造成了关键的社会挑战:防止AI产生的错误信息、深刻的假象和捏造的视觉内容。

blocks.en:
Detecting generated images through empirical classifiers has proven insufficient — such models tend to overfit to the artifacts of specific generators and fail to generalize to unseen architectures [ 1 ] . As a result, digital watermarking has emerged as the main paradigm for tracking AI-generated content: embedded imperceptible marks at the time of generation can later indicate which generation model has been used and even the exact user session. The urgency of this approach has been recognized at the policy level [ 2 ] :
the EU and China now mandate detectable marking of AI outputs, while the US is moving toward similar requirements through state law and proposed federal legislation.

通过经验分类器探测生成的图像已证明是不够的——这种模型往往过于适合特定发电机的文物,未能通通化到看不见的建筑 [1]. 因此,数字水印出现了跟踪AI生成内容的主要范式:在生成时被嵌入的无法被识别的标记可以后来表示使用了哪个生成模型,甚至准确的用户会话. 在政策一级认识到这一方法的紧迫性[2]:
欧盟和中国现在规定对AI产品进行可探测标记,而美国则通过州法和联邦立法提案向类似的要求迈进。

blocks.en: The practical security of watermarking schemes remains an open question. As new watermarking methods are proposed, new attacks are designed to remove or corrupt the embedded signal. Figure 1 illustrates this setting: a provider embeds an imperceptible watermark at generation time, after which an adversary may attempt to erase it before publication, while a verifier seeks to recover the mark from the published image. A substantial body of work has examined the vulnerability of spatial-domain and learning-based watermarks; however, one class of methods has received comparatively little scrutiny: frequency-based watermarking schemes that encode information in an image’s spectral representation.
blocks.zh: 水印计划的实际安全性仍然是一个未决问题。 随着新的水标记方法被提出来,新的攻击被设计来去除或腐蚀嵌入式信号. 图1说明了这种设置:提供者在一代人的时间嵌入了无法识别的水印,之后对手可能试图在发布前去除它,而核查者则试图从所发表的图像中取回标记. 大量工作审查了空间域和以学习为基础的水标志的脆弱性;然而,有一类方法相对很少受到审查:以频率为基础的水标志办法,将信息编入图像的光谱表示。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we expose a previously unreported vulnerability in this family of methods. We demonstrate that frequency-domain watermarks can be systematically removed via an adversarial attack that remains visually imperceptible, preserving image quality while fully neutralizing the embedded signal. To our knowledge, we are the first to systematically exploit latent-frequency masking against this class. We further discuss potential defense strategies and analyze their trade-offs.
Our main contributions are as follows: • We identify and formalize a novel attack surface in generative image watermarking: the latent-frequency representation obtained by applying the Fourier transform to a diffusion model’s VAE latent. • We propose Latent Frequency Masking (LFM) , a gradient-free removal attack that suppresses watermark evidence by replacing selected latent-frequency coefficients, with two replacement strategies — efficient Gaussian sampling and image-adaptive diffusion regeneration. • We derive a distortion bound relating the pixel-space change to the VAE reconstruction error and the masked latent-frequency perturbation, characterizing the quality–removal trade-off. • We conduct extensive experiments against six diffusion watermarking schemes on DiffusionDB and MS-COCO, showing that LFM removes or substantially weakens most while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime, and we analyze why distributed embedding (e.g., Gaussian Shading) resists it.

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: II-A Invisible Watermarking Methods
blocks.zh: II-A 隐形水标记方法

blocks.en: Digital image watermarking techniques can be categorized by the stage at which the watermark is embedded. The following classification of methods is proposed: i. post-generation methods, which apply a watermark to already generated or captured images. ii. in-generation methods, which integrate the watermark directly into the image creation process,
blocks.zh: 数字图像水印技术可以被嵌入水印的阶段分类. 建议方法分类如下: 一,后生成方法,将水印应用于已经生成或捕获的图像. 二. 将水印直接纳入图像生成过程的生成方法,

blocks.en: post-generation methods, which apply a watermark to already generated or captured images.
blocks.zh: 后生成方法,将水印应用于已经生成或捕获的图像.

blocks.en: in-generation methods, which integrate the watermark directly into the image creation process,
blocks.zh: 生成中的方法,将水印直接纳入图像创建过程,

blocks.en: Post-generation methods , which are applied to already existing images, traditionally operate in the spatial, discrete cosine, Fourier, or wavelet domains. These methods embed watermarks into selected frequency coefficients [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Contemporary neural methods adhere to the ’encoder — noise layer — decoder’ architecture pioneered by HiDDeN [ 6 ] , frequently incorporating invertible networks [ 7 ] , adversarial training, and attention mechanisms to enhance imperceptibility and robustness [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . To demonstrate resilience against geometric attacks, recent works also explore multi-region embedding [ 12 , 13 ] and synchronization patterns [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 适用于已存在的图像的后生成方法,传统上在空间、离散的宇宙圈、Fourier或波浪域运作。 这些方法将水印嵌入选定的频率系数[3,4,5]. 当代神经方法坚持由HiddeN[6]所开创的 ' 编码器-噪声层-解码器-架构,经常包含不可逆的网络[7],对抗性训练,以及增强不易知性和坚固性的注意机制[8,9,10,11]. 为了展示抵御几何攻击的韧性,近期的作品还探索了多区域嵌入[12,13]和同步模式[14].

blocks.en: In-Generation methods have become the dominant approach for AI-generated content provenance. The majority of these models operate by modifying latent representation, either before or during the diffusion process.
blocks.zh: 对AI生成的内容出处来说,Generation方法已成为主导方法. 这些模型大多通过在扩散过程之前或期间修改潜在代表来运作。

blocks.en: Tree-Ring [ 15 ] embeds a structured ring-shaped pattern in the frequency domain of the initial noise, achieving strong robustness to geometric transformations. Subsequent works [ 16 , 17 ] extended this idea with discretized ring patterns and multi-bit encoding. MaXsive [ 18 ] injects a structured X-shaped template into the latent noise to enable geometric alignment, while encoding the watermark message in separate latent components. Gaussian Shading [ 19 ] preserves the statistical properties of the noise and embeds the watermark by modulating latent variables according to predefined quantile intervals of the normal distribution. Stable Signature [ 20 ] adopts a different strategy by fine-tuning the generative model itself, specifically the VAE decoder, to imprint a watermark into the generated latent.
blocks.zh: Tree-Ring [15] 在初始噪声的频率域中嵌入了结构化的环形图案,实现了强健到几何转换. 随后的作品 [16,17] 以盘状环形图案和多位编码来扩展了这个想法. MaXsive [18] 在潜在噪声中注入结构化的X形模板来进行几何对齐,同时将水印消息编码为单独的潜在组件. Gaussian Shading [19] 保留了噪声的统计属性并嵌入了水印,根据正态分布的预先定义的等分值间隔来调节潜在变量. 稳定签名[20]采用不同的策略,对基因模型本身,特别是VAE解码器进行微调,将一个水印刻入生成的潜入.

blocks.en: Compared with post-generation watermarks, in-generation methods offer several practical advantages that motivate our focus. By weaving the mark into the sampling trajectory rather than adding it afterward, several designs achieve minimal perceptual degradation — e.g., Gaussian Shading [ 19 ] is provably distribution-preserving — while exhibiting markedly stronger robustness to conventional distortions than spatial-domain post-hoc schemes; standardized stress tests [ 21 ] confirm that methods like Tree-Ring [ 15 ] withstand perturbations on which post-hoc watermarks usually fail. This combination of quality and resilience is precisely what makes their security against adaptive, watermark-aware removal an open and consequential question — the one we examine in this work.
blocks.zh: 与后出世的水印相比,后出世的方法提供了几个实际的优势,激发了我们的注意力. 通过将标记编织入采样轨迹,而不是再加后,一些设计实现了最小的知觉退化——例如高斯沙丁[19]是可证明的分布-保留——同时对常规扭曲表现出明显更强的强度,而不是空间域的后荷克计划;标准化的压力测试[21]证实,像"树-Ring [15]"这样的方法能承受通常在后荷克水印上失败的扰动. 质量和复原力的这种结合正是使他们对适应性的、有水分意识的去除的安全性成为一个开放和随之而来的问题——我们在这项工作中审查的问题。

blocks.en: II-B Attacks on Invisible Watermarks
blocks.zh: II-B 对隐形水印的袭击

blocks.en: The robustness of watermarking schemes is determined not only by resistance to benign image distortions, but also by the strength of the attacker considered during evaluation. Standard perturbations such as JPEG compression, blur, noise, cropping, and geometric transforms remain necessary sanity checks, yet recent work shows that robustness to such distortions does not imply security against adaptive removal or forgery.
blocks.zh: 水分标记方案的稳健性不仅取决于对良性图像扭曲的抵制,而且还取决于评估期间考虑的攻击者的力量。 JPEG压缩、模糊、噪音、收割和几何变换等标准扰动仍然是必要的理智检查,但最近的研究表明,对这种扭曲的强烈性并不意味着防止适应性清除或伪造的安全。

blocks.en: One line of work studies analytical attacks that estimate the watermark directly. Yang et al. [ 22 ] show that content-agnostic watermark patterns can often be recovered by averaging multiple watermarked images and subtracting the estimated pattern, and that this estimate may even enable forgery. A second major family comprises regeneration-based attacks. Zhao et al. [ 23 ] demonstrate that invisible watermarks can be removed by first perturbing an image and then reconstructing it with a generative prior, which motivates diffusion-based baselines such as Diffusion Regeneration and Diffusion Rinsing attacks used in our experiments. Related diffusion purification and model-substitution attacks were analyzed by Saberi et al. [ 24 ] . Liang et al. [ 25 ] further show that Deep Image Prior can serve as a competitive black-box baseline, while Alam et al. [ 26 ] improve the quality–removal trade-off with saliency-aware diffusion reconstruction (SADRE).

blocks.en: Another line of work studies adaptive and optimization-based removal. Lukas et al. [ 27 ] formulate watermark evasion as an optimization problem and show that optimized attacks can substantially outperform fixed perturbation baselines. UnMarker [ 28 ] further argues that robust defensive watermarks necessarily rely on spectral carriers and introduces a universal spectral attack that succeeds without detector feedback, making it particularly relevant to frequency-based watermarking. Complementary work also considers model-level attacks: Hu et al. [ 29 ] show that decoder-rooted watermarks such as Stable Signature can be neutralized by fine-tuning the generator itself.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作研究以适应性和优化为基础的去除. 卢卡斯等. [27] 将逃取水印定为优化问题,并表明优化攻击可大大超过固定扰动基线。 UnMark [28] 进一步认为,强力防御水印必然依赖于光谱载体,并引入了无探测器反馈而成功的通用光谱攻击,使其与以频率为基础的水印特别相关. 补充性工作还考虑了模型级攻击: 胡等编. [29] 显示"稳定签名"等以解码器为根基的水印可以通过微调生成器本身来中和.

blocks.en: Finally, recent studies emphasize that removal is only one side of the threat model. Muller et al. [ 30 ] and Souček et al. [ 31 ] demonstrate realistic black-box forgery and removal attacks for diffusion and post-hoc image watermarks, with the latter corresponding to the WMForger method in our experiments. Overall, current evidence suggests that watermark robustness should be assessed not only under conventional distortions but also against steganalytic, regenerative, adaptive, and forgery-oriented attacks.
blocks.zh: 最后,最近的研究强调,清除只是威胁模式的一面。 穆勒等 [30]和苏切克等. [31] 演示现实的黑盒伪造和去除攻击,用于扩散和后热图像水印,后者与我们实验中的WMForger方法相对应. 总体而言,目前的证据表明,水印的坚固性不仅应在常规扭曲下加以评估,而且还应针对分析、再生、适应性和以伪造为目的的攻击。

blocks.en: The proposed attack encodes the image using the VAE encoder, computes the spectrum via FFT, performs masking based on a mask and a replacement vector in the frequency region, computes inverse FFT, and produces an outptut image with the VAE decoder. Figure 2 provides an overview of our Latent Frequency Masking attack. We discuss the steps of the algorithm and the rationale behind them below.

This choice is motivated by the fact that during the training of the VAE, an additional loss is used to keep the latent distribution closer to 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) \mathcal{N}(0,I) . blocks.en: III-B 2 Mask selection
blocks.zh: 三-B 2 口罩选择

blocks.en:
Selecting the correct mask is paramount for the success of the attack.
Kassis et al. [ 28 ] analyze possible locations for watermarking information based on the requirements of Universal Applicability, Universal Stealthiness, and Robustness to Manipulations. They propose that, based on these requirements, the watermark carrier must reside in the spectral domain. This motivates our choice to perform masking in the Fourier space. They also hypothesize that for ”semantic” or generative watermarks, the watermarking information will inhabit the low-frequency areas.
blocks.zh:
选择正确的口罩对于攻击的成功至关重要.
Kassis等人[28]根据通用性、通用隐蔽性以及操纵性强的要求,分析水标记信息的可能位置。 他们提议,根据这些要求,水印载体必须位于光谱域. 这促使我们选择在傅里叶空间表演口罩. 他们还假设,对于“语义”或遗传性水印,水印信息将覆盖低频地区。

To disrupt the watermark, the algorithm discards the information in the latent space guided by the mask, rendering the watermark undetectable. blocks.en:
The Lipschitz continuity of the decoder One of the assumptions in Theorem 1 is that the VAE decoder is Lipschitz continuous.
This assumption is natural for the Stable Diffusion decoder used in our experiments.
After its weights are fixed, the decoder is a deterministic map 𝒟 : ℝ H × W × C → ℝ H I × W I × 3 \mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{H_{I}\times W_{I}\times 3} implemented by a neural network.
The network is built from convolutional and linear layers, pointwise activation functions, upsampling operations, residual connections, attention blocks, and normalization layers.
The composition of Lipschitz maps is also Lipschitz, with a constant bounded by the product of the constituent constants (and by corresponding sums for residual branches).
Therefore, if all the building blocks are Lipschitz under the Euclidean norm, then the decoder also admits some finite Lipschitz constant L L .
blocks.zh:
解码器的Lipschitz连续性 第1定理中的假设之一是:VAE解码器是Lipschitz连续的.
这个假设对我们实验中使用的稳定分解码器来说是自然的.
其分量被固定后,解码器为决定地图 D:R H×W×C → R HI×W I×3\mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R} H\times W\times C\\\ times C\\ tightarrow\ mathbb{ R\\H\\i\times 时间 时间 3)由神经网络实施.
网络由演化层和线性层,指向活化函数,取样操作,剩余接通,注意力块,和常态层相接而成.
利普希茨地圖的构成也叫利普希茨,由组成常数的产物(并有相应的剩余分支之和)来固定.
因此,如果所有的构件都是在欧几利得规范下的Lipschitz,那么解码器也承认一些有限度的Lipschitz常数L.

blocks.en:
Prior work gives bounds and estimation procedures for fully connected layers, convolutional layers, pooling layers, activation functions, normalization, and residual connections
under ℓ 2 \ell_{2} , ℓ 1 \ell_{1} , and ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} norms [ 34 ] . For attention blocks, however, the situation is more complex: by itself, the standard dot-product self-attention is not globally Lipschitz for an unbounded input domain [ 35 ] .
However, it can be shown that together with normalization layers, the combined map is Lipschitz. In particular, [ 36 ] proves that for inputs of length n n restricted to any compact set, self-attention has an explicit finite Lipschitz upper bound. In the considered architecture, GroupNorm is applied before the query, key, and value projections, and since GroupNorm normalizes each channel group using variance, its output is bounded. Hence, the attention module only receives inputs in a bounded set, and the bounded-domain Lipschitz result applies. The combined map is therefore Lipschitz with a constant obtained by composing the GroupNorm, attention, and residual constants.
blocks.zh:

然而,可以表明与正常化地层一起,合并的地图是利普希茨. 特别是,[36] 证明,对于长度n 限于任何紧凑的组合输入,自意具有明确的有限Lipschitz上限。 在被考虑的架构中,GroupNorm在查询,密钥和数值预测之前被应用,由于GroupNorm使用差异使每个频道组正常化,其输出被限制. 因此,关注模块只接收到一组有界限的输入,有界限的域Lipschitz结果适用. 因此,合并地图是Lipschitz,其常数是通过组成GroupNorm、注意力和剩余常数获得的。

blocks.en:
We note that, in practice, the Lipschitz constant depends on the weights and architecture of the specific decoder network.
For a deep decoder, the worst-case bound may be somewhat loose, because the product of layer constants can be large.
We do not rely on the numerical value of L L in our attack; the assumption is used only to justify that small latent perturbations imply bounded changes in the decoded image.

blocks.en: IV-B Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 四-B 评价指标

blocks.en: We evaluate watermark erasing attacks from two perspectives: (i) how reliably the watermark can be removed using the given transformation, and (ii) how much this distortion affects the image quality.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个角度评价水印去除攻击:(一) 如何可靠地利用给定的转换去除水印,和(二) 这种扭曲对图像质量的影响程度.

blocks.en:
The first perspective concerns the reliability of watermark extraction.
Reliability evaluation depends on whether a method embeds only a detectable signal or a full binary payload. In zero-bit watermarking, the detector decides whether a watermark is present, yielding a binary detection setting.
Practical systems are usually expected to operate under strict false-alarm constraints; therefore, robustness is commonly summarized by the True Positive Rate achieved at a predefined low False Positive Rate, i.e., TPR@x%FPR, we use an FPR of 1%.
blocks.zh:
第一种观点涉及取出水印的可靠性.
可靠性评价取决于一种方法是只嵌入可探测信号还是完整的二进制有效载荷. 在零位水标记中,由探测器决定是否存在水标记,产生二进制检测设置.
实际操作系统通常会在严格的假警报限制下运行;因此,强性通常由预先定义的低假正率(TPR@x%FPR)所实现的"真正率"概括,即我们使用1%的"FPR".

blocks.en: For methods that embed multi-bit messages, extraction quality is determined by the similarity between the recovered and original payloads. Multi-bit extraction can also be interpreted as a detection problem by using the agreement between the embedded and decoded messages as a detection score. This makes it possible to compare payload-based methods with zero-bit methods using the same operating-point metrics, including TPR@x%FPR.
blocks.zh: 对于嵌入多位电文的方法,取出质量由所取出的有效载荷和原有效载荷的相似性决定. 多位取出也可以被解释为一个检测问题,通过将嵌入式和解码后的信息之间的协议作为检测分数. 这使得使用相同的操作点度量度,包括TPR@x%FPR,将基于有效载荷的方法与零位方法进行比较成为可能.

blocks.en: The second perspective focuses on the image quality. When a reference image is available, the distortion caused by the erasing method can be measured with full-reference metrics such as PSNR, SSIM [ 32 ] , and LPIPS [ 33 ] . They evaluate pixel-level correspondence between the distorted and reference images. In settings where no clean reference is available, perceptual quality can instead be estimated with no-reference image quality metrics. To this end, we employ the popular CLIP-IQA [ 40 ] model.
blocks.zh: 第二个视角侧重于图像质量. 当有参考图像可用时,可以使用PSNR,SSIM [32],LPIPS [33]等全参考度量法来测量去除方法造成的扭曲. 他们评价被扭曲和参考图像之间的像素级对应. 在无法提供清洁参考的环境下,可以通过不参考图像质量衡量尺度来估计知觉质量。 为此,我们采用了受欢迎的CLIP-IQA[40]型.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 presents a plot of attack performance vs the computation times of attacks that were used for comparison in this paper. The timings were measured on a server with an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU and averaged over the 1000 images from the DiffusionDB dataset. We do not include time for parameter search for LFM since it is performed once per watermarking algorithm and the selected parameters are reused for each tested image.
Latent Frequency Masking with Gaussian replacement strategy achieves the highest attack speed among the compared algorithms while having comparable or better attack performance. For Latent Frequency Masking with the Diffusion replacement strategy, speed is predictably comparable to Diffusion Regeneration; however, it’s notable that it performs slightly better in terms of quality and performance.

We perform an ablation study on all of the steps of the proposed algorithm on the DiffusionDB dataset to assess their importance. blocks.en: VI Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a novel attack on watermarks for diffusion-generated images.
The method operates by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the VAE latent representation and supports Gaussian and diffusion-regeneration replacement strategies. By modifying only selected frequency coefficients of the VAE latent representation, Latent Frequency Masking can substantially reduce watermark detectability while preserving most of the visual content of the original image. The Gaussian replacement variant
is particularly efficient, requiring only VAE encoding and decoding together with Fourier transforms. The diffusion-regeneration variant improves image quality in several settings by using an
image-adaptive replacement latent, although its effectiveness depends on whether regeneration itself suppresses the target watermark.

blocks.en: From a defensive perspective, the findings indicate that watermark evaluation should include latent-space and frequency-space attacks in addition to standard image distortions. Robust watermarking schemes should avoid placing most of the watermark evidence in compact, predictable latent-frequency regions. Promising directions include detector designs that remain sensitive after partial latent replacement, and training procedures that explicitly include Latent Frequency Masking as an adversarial transformation.
blocks.zh: 从防御的角度来看,调查结果表明,水印评价除了标准图像扭曲外,还应包括潜在空间和频率空间攻击。 强有力的水标记计划应避免将大多数水标记证据放在紧凑、可预测的潜在频率区域。 有希望的方向包括部分潜在替换后仍然敏感的探测器设计,以及明确将Lententt频率遮罩作为对抗性转变的培训程序。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: In conclusion, we introduced Latent Frequency Masking, a simple and efficient attack for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks in diffusion-generated images. Across multiple watermarking schemes, LFM achieves a favorable trade-off between watermark removal, perceptual quality, and computational cost, exposing weaknesses that are not captured by conventional robustness tests. We hope these results encourage stronger evaluation protocols and more robust watermark designs for generative image provenance.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们引入了Latet Centre Masking,这是一种简单而有效的攻击,用于评价无形水印在扩散生成的图像中的坚固性. 通过多个水分标记方案,LFM在去除水分、知觉质量和计算成本之间实现了有利的取舍,暴露出常规强性测试所没有的弱点。 我们希望这些成果能鼓励更强有力的评价协议和更健全的水印设计,以取自基因图象。
